newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber stable in quiet late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber stable in quiet late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in late trading on Wednesday on thin buying interest, traders said.

They said a deal was done at 44.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for September shipment in the afternoon. Offer prices were quoted at 43.50 for August shipment fob Padang, 44.50 for October shipment fob Medan, 44.00 for August shipmnent fob Surabaya and 43.75 for August shipment fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Traders said sentiment on the local market was weak as the weak ringgit against the U.S. dollar had made Malaysian rubber more competitive against the Indonesian product.
"Players appeared to have postpone making decisions until Friday as tommorow is a public holiday," one trader said.
